ENGLISH.text: Use `const`, never `var`.
Never commit to main.
Use npm, not yarn.
Run `prettier` on modified files before committing.
Write clean, maintainable code.
Use `el` and `la` as the locale keys in the map.
Name Spanish locale files `es.json` and Portuguese ones `pt.json`.
Keep the si and no answers as booleans.
Set the request timeout to 30 seconds.
Do not assume external converters are installed.
Prefer `unknown` over `any`.
Always run `npm test` before you push.
Every commit modifying `src/` must end with a passing build.
Handle errors appropriately.
Consider all inputs untrusted at the handler boundary.
Avoid `any`; prefer `unknown` when the type is genuinely open.
Document the de and fr translations in `docs/i18n.md`.
Name the daily export `menu-du-jour.csv` and nothing else.
Cut it.
Prefer a compact message format.
